name: Splat the Net
aliases: Splat the Net: Radiance Fields with Splattable Neural Primitives
definition: A method using splattable neural primitives (MLP-based density fields) instead of Gaussian primitives to represent 3D scenes, requiring roughly 10x fewer primitives than 3DGS for the same scene representation while maintaining >100 FPS rendering speed.
summary: Splat the Net is a neural primitive-based volume rendering method that replaces Gaussian kernels with splattable neural primitives, achieving comparable speed to 3D Gaussian Splatting while requiring approximately 10 times fewer primitives.
